summary: Add validation in TodoStorage.load() to verify each JSON list element is a dict before passing to Todo.from_dict(). This prevents confusing TypeError/KeyError when elements are null, strings, integers, or other non-dict types.
approach: Validate element types in storage.py load() method before calling Todo.from_dict(). This provides clear error messages with element index and actual type when validation fails.
risks: Minimal - adds validation overhead only when loading JSON files, which is already a protected operation with size limits.
